title: Display GPU AI permitted as sole GPU/NPU or with explicit application binding
accepted: One display GPU with zero other GPUs and zero NPUs may run AI with normal HRB/Router admission
Any other GPU or NPU, even if unavailable, requires affirmative per-application, per-model, per-task and per-stable-device selection
Never automatically use display GPU for aggregate throughput, load balancing, or fallback
Protect display responsiveness with HRB display safety reserve
Live inventory, central model selection, HRB lease and fresh current-host evidence remain required
forbidden: Implicit multi-GPU compute use of display GPU
An unavailable second GPU/NPU being treated as absent
Hardcoded device ordinal, vendor or desktop session assumption
